text:
Ava Chen: Quick check on the autoscale control panel mock — focusing on SLO slider, min/max inputs, and the burst toggle. Need copy + a11y pass.
Liam Patel: Main UX stink: slider default at 90% inflates min for new users. Suggest lowering soft default to 70% and show why in helper text.
Sofi Gomez: a11y: pool picker currently traps focus and duplicate headings appear in VoiceOver. Make it role=dialog and ensure focus returns to triggering button.
Marco Rivera: Copy note: users think "burst" is permanent. Two options: label as "Burst (temporary)" or add helper: "Short-term extra GPUs; billed separately."
Ellie Tran: Fallback messaging needs work. Toasts like "Fallback active" are opaque. Must indicate what falls back (requests), where (Redwood Hosted), and any privacy/perf caveats.
Ava Chen: Proposal: slider label "Reliability" with small inline hint: "Lower cost ← → Lower latency & higher reliability" and a subtle cost delta shown as you move it.
Liam Patel: Agree on cost delta. Will prototype a tiny $/hour estimate next to the slider and a hover detail for methodology.
Sofi Gomez: Also add aria-valuetext on the slider: e.g. "Reliability 70 percent. Higher reliability may increase cost." And link aria-describedby to the helper copy for pool picker.
Marco Rivera: Draft burst helper: "Temporary burst capacity: short-term extra GPUs to handle spikes. Automatically scales down after 10 minutes." Short variant: "Short-term extra GPUs (auto-removes)."
Ellie Tran: Draft fallback toast v1:
```
Fallback active: Selected GPU pool is at capacity. Routing to Redwood Hosted for availability. Data remains encrypted in transit. Reserve Dedicated capacity to avoid routing. (View details)
```
Ellie Tran: Also propose a low-contrast inline banner in the console when fallback is live linking to a modal that explains tradeoffs.
Ava Chen: Actions: Marco send final microcopy options by EOD, Liam mock cost delta + small sparkline for min/max, Sofi do keyboard/VO pass, Ellie draft fallback modal. Target: staging verify next Thurs.
Liam Patel: On it — prototyping today.
Sofi Gomez: I'll drop a11y notes in Figma tomorrow AM.
Marco Rivera: Will post 2 copy variants by EOD.
Ava Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the figma and link here when ready. :raised_hands:
